Chase Sapphire Preferred credits and when they expire

Every statement credit on the Chase Sapphire Preferred (annual fee $95), what it is worth, and when it resets. Last verified October 11, 2026.

CreditAmountResets
Chase Travel hotel credit$100 per yearEvery year, on your card anniversary
DoorDash promo (non-restaurant)
Up to $10 a month in promos on non-restaurant DoorDash orders, such as grocery and retail. Activation required. Enrollment required.		$10 per monthEvery month (last day of the month)
Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS credit$120 per four yearsOnce every four years

If you used every recurring credit above in a full year, that adds up to about $220 against the $95 annual fee. Most people use only some of them, which is why tracking matters.

Details come from the issuer's public terms and reputable reviews, and issuers change credits often. Always confirm the current terms with your issuer before relying on a credit. PerkaBoo is not affiliated with any card issuer or bank.
